periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical orientation with a slight lateral tilt at the superior margin, approximately 15 degrees from the vertical facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated teardrop or oval morphology with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the patch narrows to a point at the inferior margin, significantly below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band across the shoulder girdle, occupying approximately 40% of the vertical torso height visible from the frontal perspective.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation, approximately 2.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly convex semicircular arcs with no evidence of flattening or irregular notches.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a linear botanical element (stem) protruding from the oral cavity and extending down the ventral midline.
